name: lemeng.lake.compact
_note: 封版分区压缩·父（C 设计，2026-11-26）：从 data.lake_compact_source × data.lake_compact_index 算出待压 (source, system_book, 月)，ctl.foreach 逐月驱动子管线。
待压 = start_ym..上月 中，索引里没有该 (source, book, ym, contract_sha) 的月；正常一天只补上月与缺口。
0 个待压 = 正常 noop，不判红。
path 在父管线里拼成完整 s3 URL（子管线 src.s3 只收 ${ITER_ITEM_PATH}）；控制流（守卫/统计/索引）在平台 job data.lake_compact_index。
限 24 条/轮：回填时按批推进，避免单轮跑几小时把执行器占住。

properties.sql:
with cfg as (
  select s.source, s.start_ym, s.contract_sha, unnest(s.system_books) as system_book
  from data.lake_compact_source s where s.enabled
),
months as (
  select c.source, c.system_book, c.contract_sha, strftime(m, '%Y-%m') as ym
  from cfg c,
       generate_series(cast(strptime(c.start_ym || '-01', '%Y-%m-%d') as date),
                       date_trunc('month', (now() at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')::date) - interval '1 day',
                       interval '1 month') as t(m)
),
pending as (
  select m.source, m.system_book, m.ym, m.contract_sha
  from months m
  left join data.lake_compact_index i
    on i.source = m.source and i.system_book = m.system_book
   and i.ym = m.ym and i.contract_sha = m.contract_sha
  where i.source is null
)
select source, system_book, ym, contract_sha,
       's3://' || (select value from data.lake_config where key = 'zos_bucket') || '/lemeng/' || source || '/system_book=' || system_book || '/bizday=' || ym || '-*/all.parquet' as path
from pending
order by source, system_book, ym
limit 24
